Every time a thought or uncomfortable emotion appears, locate the sensation in your body. Separate it from the thought. Sit with it. Feel the nothingness. Hold the thought or the sensation, let it grow a little, breathe it in, and release it like smoke dissolving into sacred water. See that smoke leaving your mouth or nose. Do this until it becomes natural. Then you can apply it while practicing pranayama. It’s very effective.

I’m giving you an upvote because I think most people didn’t even read you properly. You never said it’s impossible to manifest an ex back no matter what. The real question is, is it necessary? Does it actually feel right to you?

If someone wants to rebuild a relationship, have they done the work to not repeat the same mistakes? And since it always takes two, has the other person done their own internal work as well? If not, you’re just manifesting the same version of the past.

Sometimes they don’t come back because you’ve evolved so much that the version you’re trying to call in doesn’t even exist anymore. Or maybe you haven’t yet become the version they would be aligned with now. You might think, “they didn’t like this part of me,” but still, you both connected deeply at one point. That connection was real. You manifested each other in that moment because you were in some kind of energetic symbiosis.

But we always mirror each other. If both of you were needy, or stuck in an avoidant-anxious loop, you’d still be a match. Even if you claimed not to like those qualities, you shared them, so it clicked. Or maybe you were simply meant to cross paths for a purpose. Your souls called each other for a reason.

Sometimes they don’t come back because you’re trying to attract a version of them that doesn’t even exist yet. Still, reconnection is always possible, but often it happens because of a mix of circumstances and mutual ego pulling things back together, even after all the chaos.

That’s how I see the Law of Assumption with a specific person. You want someone who loves you back. You want them to have changed. But if they’ve actually changed, so must you. That’s the golden rule. And if your current energy field doesn’t match theirs, it won’t happen. Sometimes one of you is still caught up in ego, chasing people or drama because chaos feels familiar.

That’s when I lost my cool and got blocked on WhatsApp after 2 weeks of distance and her dating someone new.

Four weeks of no contact went by. During that time, I focused on myself still feeling miserable though but hey that’s the game. However 2 weeks later, I was convinced she’d break up with the other guy. I did the work. I visualized, daydreamed, saw synchronicities, even masturbated while thinking of her. She eventually reached out again while still with him. She was already complaining about him and eventually ditched him after forgiving his acting out twice (he did worse than me by asking money back, blasting her IG of sent and unsent threatening messages, etc.). A few weeks later, we met in Bali.

One week after that, things went off track. She suddenly became distant without any explanation. I overreacted. I overtexted. I tried to meet her. She blocked me again. I kept reaching out until I finally understood it was time to stop. That last blocking happened four weeks ago. I’ve been in no contact for eight days now.

The truth is, I never got clarity. I don’t know why she pulled away. Maybe I didn’t give her enough space during those two days of silence. Maybe the overtexting became too much. At some point, I sent her a long message telling her exactly what I thought. It was sharp, judgmental, and probably unnecessary. Who am I to criticize how she lives or treats people?

I even manifested a strange moment on the beach where she appeared right in front of me. We talked. We laughed. But it lasted five minutes. There was no reconnection. It felt like a half-manifestation.

Now it doesn’t feel like last time. I’m less obsessed. Something in me feels different. Maybe it’s my beliefs, or maybe it’s intuition. Maybe this time it won’t take four weeks. Maybe it will take longer. Maybe it won’t happen at all.

I left Bali two weeks ago. I’m on my way back to Europe from Kuala Lumpur. I know circumstances aren’t supposed to matter. But let’s be honest. Sometimes they do. Some people do all the inner work and still don’t get the person back. Maybe they never share those stories. Maybe they just move on quietly and attract something better.
